battle.name: 烏爾那木征服拉格什
battle.brief: 公元前二一一〇年前後，第三王朝的奠基者烏爾那木率兵沿幼發拉底支流北上，攻克南部蘇美爾強城拉格什，將其併入烏爾。攻勢骨幹是步兵結成的長矛方陣，銅矛與大盾是列陣核心；拉格什守軍也以同型束柄銅矛據城垣抵抗。本卡那件前3200年的埃及長矛，正是同工藝階層的武器坐標。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是美索不達米亞南部的兩座城邦國家：拉格什（Lagash，今日的泰洛赫遺址）與烏爾（Ur）。拉格什方是統治南部最發達的城邦，王室稱「恩西」（ensi，即總督兼統治者），並同時擔任寧吉爾蘇（Ningirsu）大神廟「埃尼努」的最高祭司，政教兩柄合一；其領土涵蓋幼發拉底下游與哈薩河之間的整片沖積平原，控有鹽沼、穀倉、船塢與通往波斯灣的鹽業航線，並且保有前阿卡德時期那套以神廟為中心的經濟體系，這是它在阿卡德王朝崩解之後仍能迅速復興的底子。烏爾方則是第三王朝的開創者，國王烏爾那木以烏爾城為基地，把王權直接架在神廟之上：步兵由鄉村徵召與城衛組成，車兵用野驢挽具拉動的輕型四輪車，工兵大隊負責築壘、掘壕、修堤與架橋，祭司團體隨軍主持出征與戰後的犧牲典禮。拉格什一方的編制與烏爾相近，同樣以步兵、車兵與神廟人員為主體，守方倚仗的是城牆、外壕與神廟高台。值得注意的是，這不是一場國家對國家的全面戰爭，而是兩個城邦聯盟在南部平原上爭奪同一批水源、鹽田與航道的局部戰爭；第三方的烏瑪（Umma）與更北方的阿摩利特聯盟都牽動其間，拉格什與烏瑪的宿怨，使雙方的每一次出征都帶著整個南蘇美爾的利害。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were two city-states of southern Mesopotamia: Lagash, at modern Tello, and Ur. The Lagash side was the most developed city-state in the south. Its rulers held the title ensi, combining the office of governor with that of high priest of the great temple of Ningirsu at E-ninnu, so that political and religious authority were fused in one person. Its territory covered the whole alluvial plain between the lower Euphrates and the Khasa river, and it controlled the salt pans, the grain lands, the boat yards and the salt shipping lanes that ran toward the Persian Gulf, while retaining the temple-centred economic system of pre-Akkadian times; that is the base on which Lagash recovered so quickly after the collapse of the Akkadian dynasty. The Ur side was the founder of the Third Dynasty of Ur: King Ur-Nammu based the royal power directly on the temples of Ur. Its infantry was levied from the countryside together with the city guard, its chariot force used light four-wheeled vehicles drawn by onagers, work crews dug trenches, raised ramparts, repaired embankments and bridged canals, and a priestly corps followed the army to run the rites of departure and the sacrifices after victory. The Lagash army was organised on the same pattern, with infantry, chariots and temple personnel as its main components, and the defence relied on the city wall, the outer ditch and the terrace of the great temple. It is worth noting that this was not a general war between two states but a local struggle between two city alliances over the same water, salt flats and waterways. The third city of Umma and the Amorite alliance further north both pulled at the outcome, and the old hostility between Lagash and Umma meant that every expedition either side mounted carried the interests of all of southern Sumer.
people: 這場戰爭留下的名字不多，但每一個都關鍵。烏爾方的主帥是烏爾那木（Ur-Nammu，另譯烏爾納瑪），他以執政官兼烏爾城統治者的身分登上王位，隨後開啟第三王朝，在位十八年，見於《蘇美爾王表》；《烏爾那木法典》的序言把「他與其子舒爾吉、其孫阿馬爾辛三代在全國確立公道」寫成王權的第一項政績。他同時是同時代規模最大的工程主持者：烏爾的大塔與城外的「A-la」堤牆都起於他的時代；他留下的勝利碑文殘片現藏巴格達的伊拉克博物館，碑上以擊碎寧吉爾蘇的鷹獅聖徽「阿努茲」（Anzu）來記拉格什的城防與神權被摧破。拉格什方面的統治者阿庫爾加爾（Akurgal）是這場敗仗的主角；他的兒子恩梅特納（Enannatum，又稱 Enmetena）在父王兵敗後立刻起兵反攻，在伊姆吉達（Imgida）與烏加加（Ugaga）兩處擊敗烏爾的軍隊，並以自己的勝利石碑自陳這場復仇，石碑今在大英博物館與盧浮宮。恩梅特納的兒子盧伽爾-埃嫩（Lugal-ezen）接著再與烏爾對抗，烏爾那木的兒子舒爾吉在碑刻中也因此被拉格什人記名。學術層面，1920年代起倫納德·伍利（Leonard Woolley）發掘泰洛赫，才讓拉格什王宮的泥板、寧吉爾蘇神廟的佈局與「國王之船」模型重見天日，這些材料是今日重建此役的主要依據。
peopleEn: Few names survive from this war, but each one is essential. The commander on the Ur side was Ur-Nammu, also rendered Ur-Namma, who came to the throne as governor and ruler of the city of Ur and then founded the Third Dynasty, reigning eighteen years according to the Sumerian King List; the prologue of the Code of Ur-Nammu sets the establishment of justice in the land by three kings, himself, his son Shulgi and his grandson Amar-Sin, as the first duty of kingship. He was also the organiser of the largest building works of the age: the great ziggurat of Ur and the A-la embankment outside the city both belong to his reign. The fragmentary victory stele he left behind, now in the Iraq Museum in Baghdad, records the smash of the Anzu, the eagle-headed lion emblem of Ningirsu, as the sign that the walls and the godhead of Lagash had been broken. On the Lagash side the ruler was Akurgal, the loser of the affair. His son Enannatum, also called Enmetena, rose in revolt as soon as his father was beaten, defeated Ur's troops at Imgida and at Ugaga, and set down the revenge on his own victory stele, now kept in the British Museum and the Louvre. Enannatum's son Lugal-ezen carried on the war against Ur, and Shulgi, Ur-Nammu's son, appears by name in the Lagash inscriptions in consequence. On the scholarly side, the excavations of Tello begun by Leonard Woolley in the 1920s brought to light the tablets of the Lagash palace, the layout of the temple of Ningirsu and the model of the King's Boat, and those finds remain the principal basis for reconstructing this campaign.
kits: 本卡兵器是埃及長矛：早王朝時期把銅或青銅矛頭套在木杆上的步戰長矛，埃及人用它守住城垣缺口，也在異族入主時用來收復失地。要說明的是，前二一一〇年的這場戰爭裡沒有埃及人——現存文本與考古都沒有顯示埃及軍隊曾參與美索不達米亞的戰事，兩地的早期聯繫是經比布魯斯轉手的木材、銅與馬干（阿曼的銅）貿易，而不是軍隊。所以本卡兵器在這場戰役裡的位置，是一個工藝坐標：前三千二百年前後的埃及早王朝與前三千年的蘇美爾同屬青銅時代早期的同一武器階層，步戰骨幹都是束柄銅矛配大盾與短柄斧。蘇美爾方面實際使用的裝備包括：狹長脊線的銅矛頭（有中脊與銎，蘇美爾語稱 gish）、大型銅矛（gabil）、成組出土的銅斧與短匕、骨與石製箭鏃、複合弓、投石索、以木框蒙皮並加固金屬釦的矩形大盾；王族與貴族另有金屬盔與金飾，顯示金屬防具的產量仍然稀少。金屬之外的補充是車：野驢挽具拉動的四輪車，車上一名御者、一名持矛或斧的戰鬥員；馬匹要到前十八世紀才傳入兩河流域，所以所有車隊與馱運都靠野驢與牛。攻城方面沒有留下直接證據顯示當時已有撞槌或攻城塔，最可能的方式是沿城牆的斜坡段、缺口與水門攀援，並以掘進與壘土削弱牆基。陸上補給靠牛車與驢隊，水上則靠哈薩河與幼發拉底支流的蘆葦船隊。
kitsEn: The card's weapon is the Egyptian spear: a foot soldier's spear of the early dynastic period, with a copper or bronze head socketed onto a wooden shaft, used by the Egyptians to hold the gaps in a city wall and to recover lost territory when foreigners took the land. It should be said that no Egyptian took part in this war of 2110 BC: neither the surviving texts nor the archaeology show Egyptian armies in Mesopotamian fighting at this time, and the early ties between the two regions ran through the timber, copper and Magan, the Omani copper, trade handled by Byblos, and not through armies. The position of this weapon in the campaign is therefore that of a technical coordinate. Egypt of about 3200 BC and Sumer of the third millennium belong to the same weapon tier of the early Bronze Age, and the backbone of the infantry in both places was the socketed copper spear backed by the large shield and the short-handled axe. The Sumerians actually used narrow blade copper spearheads with a central ridge and a socket, known in Sumerian as gish, larger copper lances called gabil, sets of copper axes and short daggers, bone and flint arrowheads, composite bows, slings, and large rectangular shields of wood frames covered in leather and reinforced with metal studs. Metal armour was rare and belonged to the royal house and the nobility, as the gold helmet found at Ur shows. The other pillar was the chariot: a light four-wheeled car drawn by an onager, carrying a driver and a fighter with spear or axe. Horses did not reach Mesopotamia until the eighteenth century BC, so all draught work and transport fell to onagers and cattle. There is no direct evidence that battering rams or siege towers existed at this date, so the most likely methods were scaling the sloped sections of the wall, its breaches and its water gates, with mining and piled earth to undermine the base. Landward supply came by ox cart and donkey train, waterward by fleets of reed boats on the Khasa and the Euphrates distributaries.
tactics: 這場戰爭的樣式，是一次以城市為支點的攻勢加一場決定性的攻城戰。烏爾的第一步是把工程力氣用在保障自身：興修「A-la」堤牆、疏浚從幼發拉底引水的主渠、築壘設卡，把烏爾變成一座可長期供應大軍的基地；然後沿哈薩河與幼發拉底支流北上約一百五十公里，水陸並行，車隊與糧船同步推進，工兵先期在城外掘壕、壘土，切斷城郊的鹽田與田地灌溉支渠，迫使守軍收縮到城牆與神廟高台之間的狹窄地帶。攻勢的主體是步兵的長矛方陣：前排以大盾護身，矛從盾縫中水平伸出，後排交替壓上，把攻城者的雲梯牢牢壓在牆下；車兵在方陣兩翼與追擊時出擊，用野驢拉的輕車撞散守軍的反擊隊。拉格什的應對是先守後反：城牆、外壕與神廟高台構成縱深，守軍以同型銅矛據牆射擊，弓手與投石手壓制接近的方陣；城破之後，恩梅特納卻利用自己熟悉的鹽沼小道與車兵優勢，在伊姆吉達與烏加加打出反擊，證明攻方並未把戰果吃穩。追擊與善後同樣是戰術的一部分：烏爾軍在奪城之後系統性地填塞拉格什的鹽池、渠口與道路，把這座城市的經濟基礎拆散，而不只是占下城牆。
tacticsEn: The shape of this war was an offensive pivoting on a city followed by a decisive siege. Ur's first step was to put its labour into securing itself: raising the A-la embankment, dredging the main canal that drew water from the Euphrates, building ramparts and barriers, so that Ur became a base able to sustain a large army for a long time. Then the army moved north along the Khasa and the Euphrates distributaries for about one hundred and fifty kilometres, advancing by land and water together, with the wagon trains and grain boats moving in step, while work crews dug ditches and piled earth outside the city to cut the salt pans and the irrigation branches that fed the fields around it, forcing the defenders back into the narrow ground between the wall and the temple terrace. The core of the assault was the infantry phalanx of spears: the front rank sheltered behind large shields, the spears levelled out through the gaps, and the rear ranks pressed on in turn to pin the scaling ladders against the wall. Chariots worked on the flanks of the phalanx and in the pursuit, the light onager-drawn cars breaking up the defenders' counter-attacks. Lagash answered by defence first and counter-stroke later: the wall, the outer ditch and the temple terrace formed a depth, the garrison used the same type of copper spear to shoot from the parapet while archers and slingers pressed the approaching phalanx; but after the city fell, Enannatum turned the salt-marsh paths he knew and the advantage of his chariots into a counter-attack at Imgida and at Ugaga, showing that the attackers had not yet consolidated their prize. Pursuit and aftermath were likewise part of the tactics: after taking the city the Ur troops systematically filled in the salt pans, canal mouths and causeways of Lagash, dismantling the economic base of the city rather than merely occupying its walls.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。年代上，烏爾第三王朝一般繫於前二一一二至前二〇〇四年，烏爾那木在位十八年（《蘇美爾王表》），對拉格什的征伐通常放在他即位的頭幾年，約前二一一〇年前後；具體年份在不同年表體系之間有出入。地理上，烏爾在北緯三〇·九六度、東經四六·一〇度，拉格什的泰洛赫遺址在北緯三一·〇一度、東經四五·五五度，兩城直線約一百五十公里，順河而下約一百七十公里，戰役的推進軸線正是這段河道。人口與兵力的計數今存材料完全空白：碑文只留下被擊敗者的部分名字，沒有留下任何一方的出征人數、戰損、俘虜或圍城日數，因此不宜寫出任何精確數字。可以引為佐證的，是同期文字行政的產量：蘇美爾人用序數記日並把日名固定下來，尼普爾的算術泥板正是這樣為戰事編年的；烏爾那木法典的殘存文本約五十七條，是最早成文的王權法令之一。工程方面，由烏爾那木興建、其子舒爾吉續工的烏爾大塔，原始高度約三十公尺，基座約六十四乘四十六公尺，考古估算用磚數約一百七十萬塊；同一時期烏爾城的粗略人口估算落在兩萬至三萬之間。以上都是估算與斷代，不是文獻統計。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly as follows. On dating, the Third Dynasty of Ur is generally placed between 2112 and 2004 BC; Ur-Nammu reigned eighteen years according to the Sumerian King List, and his campaign against Lagash is usually put in the first years of his reign, around 2110 BC, though the exact year differs between the chronologies. On geography, Ur lies at 30.96 degrees north and 46.10 degrees east, and the site of Tello, ancient Lagash, at 31.01 degrees north and 45.55 degrees east, roughly one hundred and fifty kilometres apart in a straight line and about one hundred and seventy by river; that stretch of waterway was the axis of the advance. No count of men survives in any material: the inscriptions preserve only part of the names of those defeated, and give no figure for the size of either army, for losses, for prisoners or for the length of the siege, so no precise numbers should be quoted. What can be used as corroboration is the documentary output of the age: the Sumerians fixed day names and used ordinal numbers, which is how the arithmetic tablets of Nippur dated the fighting, and the surviving text of the Code of Ur-Nammu runs to about fifty-seven clauses, one of the earliest written statements of royal law. On works, the great ziggurat of Ur, begun by Ur-Nammu and completed by his son Shulgi, stood about thirty metres high on a base of roughly sixty-four by forty-six metres, and archaeological estimates put the brick count at about 1.7 million; the rough population estimate for the city of Ur at this time falls between twenty and thirty thousand. These are estimates and datings, not recorded statistics.
cause: 把這場征服的起因拆開，是四層原因疊在一起。第一層是經濟的：拉格什自阿卡德覆亡之後，靠鹽、穀、銅、木材與船運迅速恢復，成為南部蘇美爾的首富之城，其鹽業航線與哈薩河的水利是烏爾一樣想要、卻沒有的東西；烏爾雖有祭祀傳統與出海通道，土地鹹鹼、耕地有限，兩者的差距就是這場戰爭的燃料。第二層是結構的：古提時期沒有仲裁者，城邦之間的爭端只有戰爭一條路，拉格什的強勢本身就是對烏爾的威脅，烏爾那木即位後把「統一南部」寫成王權的第一要務。第三層是制度的準備：烏爾那木在開戰之前已經做完了三件事——以法典把徵召、納稅與刑罰固定下來，以募兵與徵召並行的方式建立常備骨幹，以堤牆與渠道整理好後方供應；沒有這三樣，任何攻城都只是災難。在這三樣之下的導火線，則是拉格什與烏瑪之間的戰事使得南部秩序失衡，烏爾以仲裁者兼強者的身分介入，終於把仲裁變成了征服。附帶的技術前提同樣重要：前三千年的兩河流域沒有攻城塔與撞槌，能依靠的只有圍城、掘進、攀援與水利，因此拿下拉格什的關鍵，是能否讓大軍在拉格什的鹽沼與渠道之間持續下去——這一點烏爾做到了，這也是它的勝利被後世記成國王之功的原因。
causeEn: Broken into its layers, the cause of this conquest has four parts. The first is economic. Since the collapse of Akkad, Lagash had recovered quickly on salt, grain, copper, timber and shipping, and had become the richest city of southern Sumer; its salt route and the waterworks of the Khasa were exactly what Ur wanted and did not have. Ur, with its ritual tradition and its outlet to the sea, had poor land, saline soils and limited acreage, and the gap between the two cities was the fuel of this war. The second is structural. Under the Gutians there was no arbiter, and the only way to settle a dispute between city-states was to fight, so Lagash's strength was itself a threat to Ur, and once Ur-Nammu was on the throne he made the unification of the south the first duty of kingship. The third is institutional preparation. Before he attacked, Ur-Nammu had already done three things: fixed levying, taxation and penalties in law, built a permanent backbone through a mixture of enlistment and conscription, and organised his rear by embankment and canal. Without those three, any siege would have been a disaster. Beneath them lay the trigger: the war between Lagash and Umma had unravelled the order of the south, and Ur intervened as arbitrator and as strongman, until arbitration turned into conquest. The technical precondition matters too. Third-millennium Mesopotamia had no siege towers and no battering rams; what was available was blockade, mining, scaling and hydraulic works, so the key to Lagash was whether a great army could be sustained among its salt pans and canals. Ur managed that, and that is why the victory came to be recorded in later tradition as a work of the king.
impact: 對蘇美爾世界，這場征服是一條時代的分界線。最直接的後果是南部蘇美爾的城邦格局被一次重排：拉格什的鹽業、耕地與船運收入轉入烏爾，烏瑪隨後也在其子舒爾吉手中淪為廢墟，烏爾從此握有海國的財源，才有餘力養常備兵、修大塔、興水利。制度上，這場戰爭的果實是三件被刻意制度化的東西——常備軍、書吏官僚與統一度量衡：尼普爾的書吏之家開始系統培養抄寫員，稅收與勞役有了固定的登記格式，法典把徵召與刑罰寫成可以下達的條文。這套組合後來成為古巴比倫與亞述的模板，兩河流域由此進入延續近三個世紀的制度成熟期，也就是學界所說的帝國時代。對拉格什而言，城市被毀而神廟的傳統沒有斷：恩梅特納重建了埃尼努的佈局，他的「國王之船」模型被奉為寧吉爾蘇的聖物，後來成為兩河流域宮廷工藝的範本；拉格什在烏爾第三王朝成為王室派遣總督駐守的重鎮，直到前二〇三〇年代伊比辛被擄走的那場災難，與烏爾一同結束。往遠處看，這場戰爭也給青銅時代早期留下一組對照：前三千二百年，埃及的早王朝正靠束柄銅矛統一尼羅河兩岸；同一件技術、同一種武器，在兩千五百公里外的蘇美爾，成為城邦走向帝國的槓桿。
impactEn: For the Sumerian world this conquest is a dividing line between eras. Its most direct effect was to rearrange the political order of southern Sumer: the salt, farmland and shipping income of Lagash passed to Ur, Umma was soon reduced to ruins under Ur-Nammu's son Shulgi, and Ur now held the wealth of the maritime south, which is what allowed it to feed a standing army, raise the ziggurat and build waterworks. Institutionally, the harvest of the war consisted of three things deliberately made permanent: a standing army, a scribal bureaucracy and standardised weights and measures. The scribal school of Nippur began training copyists systematically, taxation and labour service were recorded in a fixed format, and the code reduced levying and punishment to orders that could be issued. This combination later became the template of Old Babylonian and Assyrian rule, and Mesopotamia entered a period of institutional maturity lasting close to three centuries, what scholars call the imperial age. For Lagash itself, the city was destroyed but the temple tradition was not broken: Enannatum rebuilt the layout of E-ninnu, and his model of the King's Boat was treated as the sacred property of Ningirsu and became a model for courtly craft across Mesopotamia; Lagash remained a strongpoint where the royal house posted its governors during the Third Dynasty of Ur, until it ended together with Ur in the disaster that carried Ibbi-Sin away in the 2030s. Seen from further off, the war also leaves a pairing from the early Bronze Age: in 3200 BC the Egyptian early dynastic state was unifying the banks of the Nile with socketed copper spears, and that same technique, that same weapon, in Sumer two and a half thousand kilometres away became the lever that turned city-states into an empire.
result: 就戰役本身而言，結果是拉格什被攻破並且被拆毀。阿庫爾加爾的王權終結，寧吉爾蘇的埃尼努神廟遭到破壞，聖徽阿努茲被毀，鹽池、渠口與道路被系統填塞，烏爾那木在殘存的勝利碑文上以擊碎那面鷹獅聖徽來記錄這一役；烏爾軍在拉格什留下的第一項安排，是把這座城改為王室派遣總督（šakkanakku）駐守的重鎮。但拉格什並沒有就此消失。恩梅特納在父王兵敗之後隨即起兵，在伊姆吉達與烏加加兩處擊敗烏爾的追擊部隊，奪回城郊與鹽田，並重建神廟；其子盧伽爾-埃嫩再接再厲，以游擊與車兵襲擾拖延烏爾的南進。烏爾最終取得的不是一次乾淨的征服，而是一場需要不斷用兵去守的霸權：接下來約三十年裡，烏爾先後在拉格什方向與烏瑪方向反覆用兵，直到把南部平原完全收進王權。於是這場戰爭的落點可以這樣說：它把蘇美爾的城邦時代推向終點，同時也把新的問題留給後人——一個靠常備軍、書吏與渠網維繫的帝國，如何在沒有了外敵之後，維持自己那套昂貴的秩序。
resultEn: As a campaign the result was that Lagash was taken and then dismantled. The kingship of Akurgal ended, the temple of Ningirsu at E-ninnu was damaged, the sacred Anzu emblem was destroyed, and the salt pans, canal mouths and causeways were systematically filled in; on the fragmentary victory stele, Ur-Nammu recorded the affair by the smashing of that eagle-headed lion emblem. The first arrangement Ur made at Lagash was to turn the city into a strongpoint where a governor, the shakkanakku, sent by the king would reside. But Lagash did not disappear. As soon as his father was beaten, Enannatum rose, defeated Ur's pursuing troops at Imgida and at Ugaga, recovered the countryside and the salt pans, and rebuilt the temple; his son Lugal-ezen followed him, harrying Ur's advance with skirmishes and chariot raids. What Ur finally obtained was not a clean conquest but a hegemony that had to be defended with troops again and again: over the following thirty years Ur fought in the Lagash direction and the Umma direction in turn until the whole southern plain was securely inside the royal power. The landing of this war can therefore be put this way: it drove the age of Sumerian city-states to its end, and it left a new problem for those who came after, namely how an empire held together by a standing army, a scribal service and a canal network was to maintain its own expensive order once it had no external enemy left to confront.
